scopeNote: Four tier-1 hub stations lock the scope (Perth PTH, Inverness INV, Aberdeen ABD, Dundee DDE) — no single primary hub, unlike every other UK region packed so far. See hazard-pack.md H6 for why none is treated as subordinate to another. Caledonian Sleeper (overnight London Euston–Aberdeen/Inverness/Fort William, plus Edinburgh/Glasgow) carries verdict out-reservation and is EXCLUDED from board filtering at every station it calls within this catalog (Aberdeen, Inverness, Fort William, Mallaig) — recorded, not silently dropped. The regional boundary against future Glasgow and Edinburgh regions (Falkirk High area) is explicitly UNRESOLVED per the oracle report and the task brief for this pack — this catalog's own scope stays north of that boundary and does not include Falkirk High or any Central Belt station. See jim-handoff.md.
notes: D1 oracle is docs/rest-of-scotland-d1/oracle-clash-report.md only. No product lib/cities/rest-of-scotland/ exists yet. Not generated from GTFS. No stopIds in this file. No UK-country ledger exists yet (docs/*-ledger.md glob has only denmark-ledger.md) — this pack proceeds without one, same basis as every other UK region packed so far.

One agency family in scope: National Rail (ScotRail is a TOC within National Rail, not a separately-fed agency — report line 11). No parent/child agency structure like South Wales' Valley Lines or South Yorkshire's Supertram pairing. See hazard-pack.md H1.

National Rail modes v1: heavy rail, destination-board model (not line+terminus). BLOCKED pending DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN — see coverageGaps. Build the catalog/adapter normally per Nico's report; do not wire the token until it exists.

Four co-equal hub locks: Perth (PTH), Inverness (INV), Aberdeen (ABD), Dundee (DDE) — see nationalRailStations.hubs below and hazard-pack.md H6 for why this pack does not rank them into one primary + secondaries.

Board eligibility: ScotRail regional, CrossCountry, LNER Highland Chieftain all verdict 'in' (walk-up boardable, no check-in barrier) per oracle report §Board eligibility. Caledonian Sleeper verdict 'out-reservation' (compulsory berth booking) — EXCLUDED from boards at Aberdeen, Inverness, Fort William, Mallaig. See hazard-pack.md.

Regional boundary vs. future Glasgow/Edinburgh regions (Falkirk High area) is UNRESOLVED in both this report and Glasgow's/Edinburgh's own unbuilt draft reports. This pack does NOT attempt to resolve it and does NOT include Falkirk High or any Central Belt station. Flagged as an open D2 coordination point for whoever builds Glasgow/Edinburgh. See hazard-pack.md doNotGroup proposals.

City lands as 'Coming Soon' (status stays planned; there is no separate coming-soon enum value in registry.js) until National Rail is unblocked, same as every other UK National Rail region packed so far.

No 'lines' array is provided for National Rail — no printed route/line map to transcribe, same as every National Rail-only region packed so far. This is a flat station list (four hubs, branch termini).

License: OGL 2.0 baseline with NRE amendments for Darwin. Confidence 'unclear' on third-party rider redistribution — same open item as every other UK National Rail region. National Rail static GTFS (Transitland) is CC-BY-2.0 UK, confidence 'clear', but is reference-only per above.

nationalRailStations.note: No printed route/line map exists for National Rail in the oracle report — Darwin is a per-station real-time board, not a fixed-route product. This is a flat station list, not a 'lines' array. BLOCKED pending DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN.

hubs.name: Perth
hubs.class: hub lock — tier 1. Junction of three lines: Highland Main Line (north to Inverness), Tayside line (east to Dundee/Aberdeen), cross-country (south to Glasgow/Edinburgh). Physically one main station with east-side wing for Dundee-bound trains. Operators: ScotRail, CrossCountry, LNER — all verdict 'in'. No Caledonian Sleeper service documented at Perth in the report.

hubs.name: Inverness
hubs.class: hub lock — tier 1. Terminus of four lines: Highland Main Line, Aberdeen-Inverness line, Kyle of Lochalsh line, Far North Line. 7 platforms. Operators: ScotRail, CrossCountry, LNER Highland Chieftain (all 'in'); Caledonian Sleeper ('out-reservation', excluded from board).

hubs.name: Aberdeen
hubs.class: hub lock — tier 1. Terminus/junction: Dundee-Aberdeen line (south), Aberdeen-Inverness line (north). 6 platforms. Operators: ScotRail, CrossCountry (both 'in'); Caledonian Sleeper ('out-reservation', excluded from board).

hubs.name: Dundee
hubs.class: hub lock — tier 1. Junction of three lines: Dundee-Perth line (west), Dundee-Aberdeen line (north), Dundee-Edinburgh line (south, toward Central Belt). South branch is the unresolved regional-boundary direction — see doNotGroup proposals in hazard-pack.md. Operators: ScotRail, CrossCountry — both 'in'. No Caledonian Sleeper service documented at Dundee in the report.

branchTermini.name: Kyle of Lochalsh
branchTermini.class: branch terminus, west coast, Inverness-Kyle line. ScotRail only ('in'). End-of-line, no through-running to other regions.

branchTermini.name: Thurso
branchTermini.class: Far North Line terminus, northernmost passenger railway in Great Britain. ScotRail only ('in'). No through-running.

branchTermini.name: Wick
branchTermini.class: Far North Line terminus. ScotRail only ('in'). No through-running.

branchTermini.name: Mallaig
branchTermini.class: West Highland Line terminus (Inverness-Mallaig). ScotRail ('in'); Caledonian Sleeper calls nights only ('out-reservation', excluded from board).

branchTermini.name: Fort William
branchTermini.class: West Highland Line, through-running to Inverness. ScotRail, CrossCountry (both 'in'); Caledonian Sleeper calls nights only ('out-reservation', excluded from board).
